entities.summary: Wan Junaidi bin Tuanku Jaafar is a Malaysian politician, lawyer and former senior police officer who served as the eighth Yang di-Pertua Negeri of Sarawak since 2024. A member of Parti Pesaka Bumiputera Bersatu, he previously served as the president and a member of senate in Dewan Negara from June 2023 until his resignation in January 2024.
